inputs: text parts extracted from books/ (pdf->pdftotext, scanned->ocr, epub->xhtml strip, mobi->mobi pkg)
invariants: raw_claim layer never contains BTC/crypto/V8 terminology not present in source
every field carries a provenance label (SOURCE_EXPLICIT | SOURCE_DERIVED | MARKET_TRANSLATION | V8_OPERATIONALIZATION | EXPERIMENTAL_ASSUMPTION | V8_DEFAULT | UNRESOLVED)
no silent inference: anything not in the source is marked UNKNOWN / NOT_SPECIFIED or provenance-tagged
no extraction quota: a book may yield 0 or many valid claims
independent extraction A/B + adjudication for executable rules
source claims are never deleted or merged; synthesis links them
backtest research is strictly separated from book research
